subject: The feature 89 users found by accident
preview_text: Most users miss this — but it's the reason dogs lose 15% weight. Check your app now.
body_paragraphs: Remember when you first got PupShape? You probably tapped around, set up your dog's profile, and thought you'd seen it all. But there's one feature that 89 users stumbled on by accident — and it's the reason their dogs dropped 15% weight in 8 weeks. I almost didn't include it because it seemed too simple.

It's the Before/After Photo Timeline. Not just a gallery — you snap a photo of your pup on Day 1, then every 2 weeks. The app stacks them side-by-side so you see the change in their waist, energy, and joy. Most users skip it because they think "my dog looks fine" — but that first comparison is what makes the weight loss real. One user told me their vet was shocked at the 4-week progress.

Open PupShape and go to your dog's profile. Scroll down to 'Timeline.' Snap your first photo if you haven't — even if they're just standing there. Then mark your calendar for 2 weeks from now. The second photo is where the magic happens. You'll see the difference before the scale moves.
Tap 'Timeline' in the app and upload a photo right now. It takes 10 seconds. P.S. — The 2-week mark is when most dogs lose their first pound. Don't miss seeing it happen.
cta_text: Open PupShape: Dog Weight Loss Plan
